ap_statistics-m01.set_intro: A dispatcher records the distance and the delivery time for nine randomly selected delivery routes of a courier company. The table shown gives the data. The least-squares regression line for all nine observations is $\hat{y} = 14.21 + 1.834x$, where $x$ is the distance and $\hat{y}$ is the predicted delivery time, and the correlation is $r = 0.87$.

stimulus.description: Data on distance and delivery time

data.title: Distance and delivery time of nine observations

items.stem: What is the residual for the observation with distance equal to $12$ kilometers? (Use the given line and round to two decimal places.)

options.why: Reports the predicted value instead of the residual.
Leaves the intercept out of the predicted value before subtracting.
